t: A low cost TI chip with strong analog parts for sensors and robot cars.
steps: Buy the LP-MSPM0G3507 LaunchPad from DigiKey for about 20 US dollars.
Find a micro USB cable that carries data, as the board uses the older plug.
Install the free TI Code Composer Studio and the MSPM0 SDK.
Plug in the LaunchPad and open a simple LED example from the SDK.
Build and flash the example through the onboard debugger.
Try the analog input example with the light sensor next.
Explore Zephyr or the Embassy Rust project later for other ways to code it.
meta: Open Board. From $20.39. A few stores.
